prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision described in your insured's file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, and confirm in writing the identity of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and total-loss appraisals, recorded statements, claim notes, and any dash camera or witness material in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this representation and your response to the requests above.
